title: Katrina
summary_html: Katrina is a recurring character and one of the companions of the Avatar. A native of Earth,[1] Katrina possesses a longevity typical of many Terrans dwelling in Britannia, with appearances spanning the centuries of Ultima IV, Ultima V, Ultima VI, Ultima VII, and Ultima IX.
